# Offline visualization assets

These pinned packages are redistributed under their included licenses:

| Package | Version | Source | License file |
|---|---|---|---|
| Papa Parse | 5.4.1 | npm `papaparse` | `papaparse-LICENSE` |
| Cytoscape.js | 3.29.2 | npm `cytoscape` | `cytoscape-LICENSE` |
| Lucide | 0.468.0 | npm `lucide` | `lucide-LICENSE` |

The viewer uses local scripts and system font fallbacks. It does not fetch
scripts, fonts, or dataset contents from third-party services at runtime.
